proposals.rationale: C0003 is an exception that explicitly relaxes the seating and safety belt requirements of paragraph (a)(3) (C0002) for dock personnel during seaplane and float-equipped rotorcraft surface operations. In accordance with relationship guidelines, its kind is updated to exception, relation to exception, modality to not_stated, and qualifies set to C0002.
proposals.quote: For seaplane and float equipped rotorcraft operations during movement on the surface, the person pushing off the seaplane or rotorcraft from the dock and the person mooring the seaplane or rotorcraft at the dock are excepted from the preceding seating and safety belt requirements.

proposals.rationale: Add companion exception for the carve-out 'except as outlined in § 91.108(j)' embedded in paragraph (a)(3)(i), which qualifies the permission in C0004.

scope_quotes: (i) Be held by an adult, except as outlined in § 91.108(j), who is occupying an approved seat or berth, provided that the person being held has not reached his or her second birthday and does not occupy or use any restraining device;

observations.rationale: The general exemption for operations conducted under part 121, 125, or 135 is a standalone section-wide exemption without a specific single-rule target, correctly represented as an exemption under C0015.
